scene: The dryer clicks, projecting three cosmic transit portals across the storefront.
picture: A flat side view along checkered tiles. On the left, an open exit reveals a waiting yellow street tram. The player stands left-of-centre in her yellow raincoat, green boots, and afro, holding a red umbrella. At centre stands a lit ticket booth for a ferry, and right is a docked red cable car.
shown: a glowing yellow street tram stopped outside the open exit on the left
a blue harbour ferry ticket counter lit up brightly at the centre
a suspended red cable car cabin waiting at a platform on the right
